C56 on screen. 15 Aug 1971: the US stopped exchanging dollars for gold (for foreign governments; Federal Reserve History, 'Nixon Ends Convertibility'); Bretton Woods collapsed by 1973 and rates floated (Lehnen, 'Reflections on Mint Years', Mar 2025). v4: the date card under the date; Nixon follows.
